outcome: salivary microbiome diversity (alpha and beta diversity)
cohort: The study included 37 women during their second and third trimesters of pregnancy who provided participant-collected salivary samples.
finding: The salivary microbiome demonstrated stability throughout the second and third trimesters of pregnancy, but differences in beta diversity were observed in individuals diagnosed with preeclampsia and in Hispanic individuals compared to non-Hispanic individuals.
cross-section timing: Samples were collected and analyzed during the second and third trimesters of pregnancy.
gest_age: Second and third trimesters of pregnancy
